Acknowledge a message (also marks as read)

Usage: am mail ack --project <PROJECT_KEY> --agent <AGENT_NAME> <MESSAGE_ID>

Arguments:
  <MESSAGE_ID>  Message ID

Options:
  -p, --project <PROJECT_KEY>  Project key
  -a, --agent <AGENT_NAME>     Agent name
  -h, --help                   Print help
